routes.name: Visa-free visit (up to 90 days)
routes.summary: Citizens of visa-exempt countries can stay up to 90 days without a permit. Extensions must be requested before day 90.

other: The official visa-exempt list was not found on the pages read. Check evisa.gov.bw or a Botswana embassy for your passport.

stay.note: Extension needs a justification letter and a host support letter, about 3 days to process.

sources.label: Botswana gov: Extension of days of visit

routes.name: Visitor's Visa
routes.summary: For visa-required nationals visiting friends or relatives. Apply on the eVisa portal or at an embassy. No work allowed.

other: Needs an affidavit from the host and a certified copy of the host's ID or permit.
Fees and exempt list not shown on the page.

steps: Apply at evisa.gov.bw, or in person with Form 1 at an immigration office or embassy.
If approved but unprinted, the approval letter works as proof and the visa is printed at the port of entry.

routes.name: Employment Visa
routes.summary: Entry visa for visa-required nationals who hold a valid work and residence permit.

other: Needs a waiver from the Department of Labour and Social Security.
No fees shown on the page.

steps: Apply at evisa.gov.bw or in person with Form 1.
Combine documents into one PDF for online applications.

routes.name: Residence Permit (immigrant, dependant, spouse of citizen, student)
routes.summary: Apply at any Immigration office. Categories include immigrants, dependants, students and spouses of citizens.

other: Immigrants need proof of support and a bank statement.
Spouse of a citizen needs a marriage certificate and a support letter.
Permit length not stated on the page.

steps: Submit at any Immigration office and pay the fee.
Approval is a sticker in your passport.

routes.name: Permanent Residence
routes.summary: Open after more than 5 years of lawful continuous residence. Investors can apply with less.

other: More than 5 years lawful and continuous residence (immigrants, dependants, missionaries, employees).
Investors may apply with under 5 years.
Good character, contributions to Botswana, enough means to support yourself and dependants.

steps: Fill in Form 21 with documents and fee.
Submit at any Immigration and Citizenship office.
routes.processing: Page says 56 working days and also six months.

routes.name: Citizenship by Naturalization
routes.summary: Needs 10 years total residence, with the last 12 months continuous. You must renounce your other citizenship.

other: 10 years aggregate residence, last 12 months continuous before applying.
Language requirement and fees not listed on the page.

citizenship.note: Page says you must renounce foreign citizenship before the certificate is issued.

steps: Fill in Form L with certified documents and police report forms.
